governingStatute: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 read with Notification No. 13/2017-Central Tax (Rate)
statutorySection: Section 9(3) of CGST Act, 2017 read with Section 31(3)(f) and Section 31(3)(g)
title: Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) mandatory tax liability on recipient, self-invoicing, payment voucher issuance, and electronic cash discharge
plainTextSummary: Under Section 9(3) of the CGST Act, 2017 read with Notification No. 13/2017-Central Tax (Rate), the government specifies categories of supply of goods or services the tax on which shall be paid on reverse charge basis by the recipient of such supplies, and all the provisions of the Act apply to such recipient as if they were the person liable for paying the tax. Specified corporate supplies include Goods Transport Agency (GTA) services, legal services provided by an individual advocate or senior advocate, services provided by directors to a company, sponsorship services, and security personnel services. Crucially under GST law, RCM tax liability cannot be discharged using accumulated input tax credit (ITC) and must be paid strictly in cash via the Electronic Cash Ledger. Under Section 31(3)(f), the recipient must issue a 'Self-Invoice' on the date of receipt of goods or services from an unregistered supplier, and a 'Payment Voucher' under Section 31(3)(g) at the time of making payment. Once discharged in cash, the RCM tax paid is eligible for input tax credit under Section 16(2) in the same tax period.

specifiedRcmCategories: Goods Transport Agency (GTA) not opting for forward charge 12%
Legal services provided by individual advocates / firms of advocates
Services provided by a Director of a company/body corporate to the company
Services by way of sponsorship to any body corporate or partnership firm
Services provided by way of supply of security personnel to a registered person
keyStatutoryThresholds.mandatoryCashPaymentRule: RCM liability CANNOT be adjusted against Electronic Credit Ledger (ITC); must strictly be discharged via Electronic Cash Ledger under Section 49(4)
keyStatutoryThresholds.selfInvoiceMandate: Section 31(3)(f): Recipient liable to pay tax under Section 9(3) or 9(4) must issue a self-invoice within 30 days of receiving supply from unregistered supplier
keyStatutoryThresholds.paymentVoucherMandate: Section 31(3)(g): Recipient must issue a Payment Voucher at the time of making payment to the supplier
keyStatutoryThresholds.itcEligibilityTiming: Tax discharged under RCM in month M is eligible for full ITC in month M under GSTR-3B Table 4(A)(3), provided underlying supply is for business purposes and not blocked under Section 17(5)
